text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a larger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can make unfair decisions if they are trained on unbalanced data. This raises questions about fairness and equal treatment for all users. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and analyses personal information. Companies and governments should also be transparent about how these systems work. Responsible AI development means designing technology that respects human rights, avoids harm, and benefits everyone. As AI continues to grow, we all have a role in making sure it is used in an ethical way.
